title: Stable registry project identity
body:
Subject: work:bw_work_91ea3e65bf848373
Status: verified
Priority: high

## Outcome

WHY: cross-workspace reference URIs (sprint G3) are keyed by registry project id, and dangling-reference recovery requires that unlinking then relinking the same project restores the same id. Today ProjectRegistryEntry.id (packages/core/src/project-registry.ts lines 35-58) has no documented stability contract. WHAT: derive the id deterministically from durable project identity - prefer the project config identity recorded at bwrk install time (projectConfigPath contents) over filesystem path, with a documented fallback chain (config id, then git remote fingerprint, then normalized path hash) and a collision policy. Registry add and import-setup paths compute it the same way; relinking a previously archived entry reuses the archived entry rather than minting a new one. Write the contract into the design doc and cover with unit tests including move-the-repo and unlink-relink scenarios. Keep the registry schema version bump additive with migration for existing entries.

## Evidence

- bw_evidence_7348dfda1f179994: passed Implemented stable project registry identity and lifecycle v2: config-derived IDs, v1 migration, archive-by-default unlink with purge, moved-checkout path rebasing, dashboard filtering for archived rows, schema/docs updates, and tests for unlink/relink plus moved relink.
- bw_evidence_fd51e41b851d7766: passed pnpm check passed; focused registry CLI/core tests passed; full cli/core runtime suites passed; install and console registry contract tests passed; docs check, git diff --check, sync refresh, and strict doctor passed after operation prune.
